name: Historic Mosque City of Bagerhat
bn_name: ঐতিহাসিক মসজিদ শহর বাগেরহাট (ষাট গম্বুজ মসজিদ)
highlights: Sixty Dome Mosque (60 Gombuj), Khan Jahan Ali Tomb, Singar Mosque, 360 mosques built of burnt brick.

name: Ruins of the Buddhist Vihara at Paharpur (Somapura Mahavihara)
highlights: One of the largest Buddhist monasteries in Asia south of the Himalayas, terracotta plaques, central stupa.

name: The Sundarbans Mangrove Forest
highlights: World's largest contiguous halophytic mangrove forest, home of the Royal Bengal Tiger, spotted deer, and Sundari trees.

name: Lalbagh Fort (Fort Aurangabad)
highlights: Tomb of Pari Bibi, Lalbagh Mosque, Subahdar Diwan-i-Aam, subterranean water canals.

name: Ahsan Manzil (The Pink Palace)
highlights: Former official residential palace and seat of the Nawab of Dhaka on the banks of Buriganga River, now a national museum.

name: Mahasthangarh
highlights: Earliest fortified urban archaeological site discovered in Bangladesh, Govinda Bhita, Bairagir Bhita, Karatoya River.

name: Kantajew Temple (Kantaji Mandir)
highlights: One of the most magnificent religious terracotta architectures in South Asia depicting scenes from the Mahabharata.

name: Mainamati Ruins (Shalban Vihara)
highlights: 115 monastic cells around a central sanctum, terracotta figurines, ancient bronze statues, archaeological museum.
